node.statement: Under the root hypotheses there are m >= 1 and nonzero finite-dimensional Hilbert spaces L_j such that B=direct-sum_{j=1}^m B(L_j); complete positivity of the UCP map Delta gives finite-dimensional Hilbert spaces E_j, provisionally allowed to be zero, and operators W_j:H->L_j tensor E_j satisfying sum_j W_j^*W_j=I_H and Delta(X)=sum_j W_j^*(X_j tensor I_Ej)W_j for every X=(X_1,...,X_m) in B; complete positivity and unitality of Phi give a finite-dimensional Hilbert space F and an isometry V:H->H tensor F satisfying Phi(T)=V^*(T tensor I_F)V for every T in B(H).
